none: PAS NLM-6A8B62: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), issue of 321-323, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust draped either laureate or with radiate crown left. Obverse inscription: CO[--]NVSI[--]NC. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VO / TIS / XX, three stars above. Reverse inscription: [BEAT]A [TRANQVILLITAS]. Mintmark: Ab in field right. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this…
